comment.body: Thanks—the report establishes that a Microsoft Store Preview install will not enter administrator mode for your Mouse Without Borders setup. Please share the exact PowerToys version, whether you used **Restart PowerToys as administrator** or **Always run as administrator**, and what happens at the UAC prompt or afterward, including any visible error. Immediately after one failed attempt, add a comment containing `/bugreport` so the generated ZIP captures the runner restart and elevation logs.
